svg.title: Federated Identity
svg.desc: Federated Identity. Let an external identity provider authenticate users; the application trusts its tokens. Step 1, Accounts in every app: The app keeps everyone's password hash and MFA. Bo leaves the partner; his account stays active. Step 2, Trust an identity provider: Users sign in at their own identity provider; the app checks the signed token and starts a session. Step 3, One broker, many providers: The app trusts one broker. It finds Bo's provider by email domain and maps his group to a role. Step 4, Accounts end at the source: The partner disables Bo: sign-in fails at his IdP, his session ends and SCIM deletes his profile.

g.text: The app keeps everyone's password hash and MFA. Bo leaves the partner; his account stays active.
Users sign in at their own identity provider; the app checks the signed token and starts a session.
The app trusts one broker. It finds Bo's provider by email domain and maps his group to a role.
The partner disables Bo: sign-in fails at his IdP, his session ends and SCIM deletes his profile.
each trust is set up once, from metadata:
